openwrt_hwdata.Comments_: 1. Since OpenWrt 24.10 ipq806x devices have switched to DSA architecture so upgrading from earlier versions to 24.10.x or later requires *complete reset* of router configuration.  2. Hardware flow offloading to NSS cores is only available in custom builds.

openwrt_wiki.einleitung: Netgear R7800 is a dual-core 1.7 GHz AC2600 router with the IPQ8065 SoC, 2xQCA9984 4x4 WLAN, 512 MB RAM, and 128 MB flash (about 80 MB free flash space after installing OpenWrt). It is loosely based on QCA's AP161 reference board.
openwrt_wiki.hinweis_dsa: Since OpenWrt version 24.10, CPU target ipq806x switched from swconfig to DSA ... upgrading from earlier versions to 24.10 or later requires complete reset of all router configuration.
openwrt_wiki.installation: Stock-GUI Advanced > Administration > Firmware Update mit -factory.img, getestet mit V1.0.2.92; factory und sysupgrade funktional gleich
openwrt_wiki.tftp: Strom aus, Reset halten, Strom an, Power-LED blinkt ca. 8x orange, dann weiß -> Reset loslassen, sofort tftp -i 192.168.1.1 put <factory.img>; LAN 4 bevorzugt, manche nur über WAN erfolgreich

lauf.notiz: ToH-Dump + Live-hwdata, OpenWrt-Wiki (inkl. Bootlogs, 2 Fotos), OpenWrt-Commit/DTS/generic.mk, Gluon-Target und -Commits, DeviWiki (WikiDevi-Spiegel identisch), Netgear-Datenblatt D-R7800-5 und Handbuch 202-11596-06, OpenWrt-Forum 285 (Beiträge 1-6). Keine Werkstatt-Protokolle. FCC-Dokumente gesperrt (fccid.io, fcc.report, apps.fcc.gov). Zwei NAND-Bestückungen (Micron/Macronix). Offen: Leistungsaufnahme, Hohlbuchsenmaß, Antennenstecker, Lüfter, FCC-Fotos. openwrt.org lehnt TLS mit nur X25519 ab (handshake failure), Abruf mit --curves X25519:prime256v1.
